verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal has a first-party API Reference with per-endpoint pages (e.g. /api-reference/Call-Log/readUserCallLog) and a 'Your first API call' guide, so a browsable reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at common paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples within the reference, a public machine-readable spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
